mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT BOOKSET_ID , BOOKSET_NAME FROM BOK_BOOKSET order by BOOKSET_ID

SELECT DISTINCT TABLE_ID , TABLE_NAME FROM BOK_TABLELIST WHERE 1 = 1
and (TABLE_ID like '%' || #{likeStr} || '%' or TABLE_NAME like '%' || #{likeStr} || '%')
order by TABLE_ID

SELECT VOUCH_REMARK as vouchRemark, /* 摘要 */ NVL(B.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO, B.SUBJECT_NO) AS subjectNo, /* 科目号 */ NVL(bbd.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NAME, bs.SUBJECT_NAME) AS subjectName, /* 科目名称 */ DECODE(B.CD_FLAG, 'D', B.B_HAPPEN_AMT, null) dBHappenAmt,/*借方金额（本币）*/ DECODE(B.CD_FLAG, 'C', B.B_HAPPEN_AMT, null) cBHappenAmt,/*贷方金额（本币）*/ DECODE(B.CD_FLAG, 'D', B.HAPPEN_AMT, null) dHappenAmt,/*借方金额（原币）*/ DECODE(B.CD_FLAG, 'C', B.HAPPEN_AMT, null) cHappenAmt, /*贷方金额（原币）*/ B.ccy AS ccy, /*原币币种*/ B.HAPPEN_NUMBER AS happenNumber /*数量*/ ,B.TRADE_ID FROM bok_VOUCH_DETAIL B JOIN bok_VOUCH_MAIN A ON A.VOUCH_NUM = B.VOUCH_NUM LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bb ON BB.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT bs ON bs.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AND bs.SUBJECT_NO = B.SUBJECT_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_BUSS_DETSUB bbd ON bbd.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID AND bbd.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO = B.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO WHERE A.BUS_VOUCHNUM = #{busVouchnum} AND A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
